prompt: Rendered in the style of a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a quiet village market at dawn. On the far left, an elderly woman in a blue shawl sits on a wooden crate, her posture slumped in early morning fatigue. Next to her rests a woven basket overflowing with bright red apples, the fruit rendered with soft graphite shading. A brown dog with floppy ears lies curled beside the crate, its tail tucked neatly under its paws. In the center foreground, a young boy in a striped shirt points eagerly toward a stack of clay pots, his finger extended sharply. Standing behind the pots is a potter in a dusty apron, looking at the boy with a gentle, amused expression. To the right of the potter, a tall man in a green hat holds out a silver coin, handing it to a vendor whose hands are obscured by a large sack of grain. The vendor, wearing a white headwrap, accepts the payment while leaning against a sturdy wooden table. Perched atop the table is a rooster with vibrant plumage, standing alert and facing left. Behind the rooster, a bicycle with a rusted frame leans precariously against a stone wall, its front wheel turned slightly inward. In the background, a child in a yellow dress runs past a hanging lantern, her hair flying back from the motion. There is no electric lighting visible in the scene, preserving the natural dawn atmosphere. There is no modern signage or plastic packaging, ensuring the historical rustic feel remains intact. The elderly woman looks at the brown dog, creating a silent bond between them. The boy in the striped shirt stands next to the stack of clay pots, bridging the gap between customer and craft. The man in the green hat interacts directly with the vendor through the exchange of currency. The rooster remains isolated on its perch, observing the transactions below without participation. The bicycle serves as a static anchor on the right side, contrasting with the dynamic movement of the child in the distance. The light color wash adds subtle warmth to the otherwise monochromatic lines, highlighting the textures of the wood, fabric, and stone.
